name: Imperial Iron Wall
extDescription: Cards cannot be removed from play.

name: Book of Life
extDescription: Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard and remove from play 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, destroy and remove from play the monster(s).

name: Call of the Mummy
extDescription: Once per turn, if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your hand.

name: Card Destruction
extDescription: Each player discards their hand and draws the same number of cards they discarded.

name: Card of Safe Return
extDescription: When a monster is Special Summoned to the field from your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

name: Cold Wave
extDescription: This card can only be activated at the start of your Main Phase 1. Until your next turn, you and your opponent cannot play or Set any Spell or Trap Cards.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Each player selects 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Des Lacooda
extDescription: Once per turn,you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, draw 1 card.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls. You can then Set 1 Spell or Trap Card from your hand.

name: Field Barrier
extDescription: Field Spell Cards cannot be destroyed. Also, a new Field Spell Card cannot be activated. You can only control 1 face-up "Field Barrier".

name: Gernia
extDescription: If this face-up card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, Special Summon it during your next Standby Phase.

name: Getsu Fuhma
extDescription: If this card battles a Fiend or Zombie-Type monster, destroy that monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Magical Arm Shield
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack while you control a monster. Take control of 1 of your opponent's face-up monsters, except the attacking monster, until the end of the Battle Phase. It is attacked instead.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
extDescription: Discard 2 cards. Add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Malevolent Mech - Goku En
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, this card is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase if it is the only Zombie-Type monster on the field. When it it sent to the Graveyard by this effect, you take damage equal to its ATK.

name: Marionette Mite
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to take control of 1 face-up Fiend or Zombie-Type monster your opponent controls until the End Phase this turn.

name: Paladin of the Cursed Dragon
extDescription: Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie-Type monster that was destroyed by battle from your opponent's Graveyard to your side of the field.

name: Patrician of Darkness
extDescription: The controller of this card selects the targets of their opponent's attacks.

name: Plague Wolf
extDescription: Once per turn, you can change this card's ATK to twice its original ATK. If you do, destroy it during the End Phase.

name: Pot of Avarice
extDescription: Select 5 Monster Cards in your Graveyard. Return those cards to the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Pyramid Turtle
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

name: Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon
extDescription: You can Tribute Summon this card in Attack Position by Tributing 1 Zombie-Type monster. When this card destroys a Zombie-Type monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.

name: Regenerating Mummy
extDescription: When this card is sent from your hand to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, return it to your hand.

name: Ribbon of Rebirth
extDescription: If the equipped monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it to your side of the field during the End Phase.

name: Royal Keeper
extDescription: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is flipped face-up, it gains 300 ATK and DEF until the end of the turn. (If attacked, this effect resolves after damage calculation.)

name: Ryu Kokki
extDescription: If this card battles a Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster, destroy that monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Shrink
extDescription: Select 1 face-up monster on the field. The original ATK of that monster is halved until the end of this turn.

name: Soul Taker
extDescription: Destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Then, your opponent gains 1000 Life Points.

name: Spell Shattering Arrow
extDescription: Destroy all face-up Spell Cards your opponent controls. For each destroyed Spell Card, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Spirit Reaper
extDescription: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. Destroy this card when it is targeted by the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster. If this card successfully attacks directly, your opponent randomly discards 1 card.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Tutan Mask
extDescription: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that targets 1 face-up Zombie-Type monster and destroy it.

name: Waboku
extDescription: You take no Battle Damage this turn. Your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

name: Zombie Master
extDescription: Once per turn, you can send 1 Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie-Type Monster from either player's Graveyard.

name: Zombie World
extDescription: All monsters on the field and in any Graveyard become Zombie-Type monsters. Neither player can Tribute Summon monsters, except Zombie-Type monsters.

name: Zombie World Structure Deck
extDescription:
Each Zombie World Structure Deck contains:

1 Preconstructed Deck of 40 cards
• 1 Ultra Rare
• 39 Commons
1 Rulebook
1 Dueling Guide
1 Playmat
